project: Team town hall invitation for the team chat (sample; the date and room are placeholders for the real ones)
audience: The whole customer care team, reading on a phone between calls
one_message: Come to the town hall with one question you want answered.
action: Think of a question and turn up
tone: Warm, plain, respectful. An invitation, not a summons.
direction: A giant serif-italic question mark standing in the orange ring; a pale sky band at the foot for the three facts
must_not: the company logo redrawn by hand
